about_the_game:
DEMO INFO

"Mr. Hoob! Demo" is a short content based demo meant for feedback that will help us finish the vibrant 3D platformer it will become. Based on the eerie charm of a fake lost media post that went semi-viral in 2025, "Mr. Hoob!" is a big deal to some lost media fans. Play the Demo this Steam Next Fest (October 2025), and leave any feedback possible! Players control a cheerful, pink character who leaps across floating platforms with a permanent smile. The demo shows off 4 levels that help visually explain different settings that will be shown in the full game.

PLATFORM HOPPING

While platform hopping is be a crucial game mechanic in the full game, the demo only requires jumping in the first level!

CONTROLS

Use WASD to Walk and SPACEBAR to Jump! You will learn more controls required to play the game in the full game's release!

FALLING

Don’t worry! If you fall you WILL respawn!

REWARDS

The player can unlock hats, levels, and achievements as they explore the demo!

GAMEPLAY STYLE

It is played in third person with a cartoonish style! Remember that everything is subject to change!

LORE

Abern Veni (played by Chad Hersh) was the creator of the game in 2006. Abern promises to visit players if they beat his game, but he unfortunately passed away due to an ailment. Fast forward to 2025 some indie game developer made a remastered version of the game that supposedly has Abern's Soul trapped inside. The players ultimate goal is to free Abern. (The demo shows and explains none of this.)

DISCLAIMER

THIS DEMO IS MEANT FOR FEEDBACK AND IS NOT WHAT TO EXPECT ON RELEASE
